newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - St. Jude Medical raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - St. Jude Medical raised.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it upgraded St. Jude Medical Inc to buy from hold.
-- said that at St. Jude's recent meeting with analysts, the company revealed plans to improve sales growth and profitability in the next two years.
-- said a combination of a broader and better product mix, with more efficient sales, manufacturing and research and development processes, will boost performance.
-- raised its 1998 earnings estimate to $2.10 a share from $1.95, and raised the 1999 estimate to $2.50 from $2.25.
-- set a 12-month price target of $42-$43 a share.
